name: Paradise Cave
kicker: Dry cave on a wooden walkway
summary: Dry boardwalk cave: walk about a kilometre inside at Km 16, the other half-day beside the boat. A buggy or a forest path covers about 1.6 kilometres, then about 500 metres to the mouth. An adult pays 270,000 VND on one tariff, buggy included, and 250,000 VND on another. Ask the gate which hours are posted for the one-kilometre walk.
getThere: Km 16, west Ho Chi Minh road. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Visitors on the wooden walkway inside Paradise Cave

notice.title: Two prices for the short walk
notice.body: 270,000 VND on one tariff, buggy included, and 250,000 VND on another. One clock runs 06:30–17:00. Confirm the price and the one-kilometre gate hours before you go.

body: This is the dry cave. Buy the ticket at the site, cross about 1.6 kilometres of forest by electric buggy or on foot, walk about 500 metres to the entrance, and follow a wooden path for about a kilometre. The cave is 31.4 kilometres long, 60 metres high, and from 30 metres to 100 metres wide, with some sections to 150 metres. The one-kilometre walk goes through chambers up to 150 metres wide and 100 metres high. A British cave expedition found the entrance in 2005. An adult pays 270,000 VND, buggy included, or 250,000 VND on another tariff. A child from 1.1 metres to 1.3 metres pays 145,000 VND. Under 1.1 metres is free.

The seven-kilometre tour uses a different clock. It starts at 08:00, kayaks an underground river 60 to 100 metres across, reaches an opening called Heaven’s Well, and is back at the center about 16:00. It costs 2,000,000 VND and needs at least two people. The overnight version is 4,000,000 VND, needs at least five people, and is closed to children under 16 and to people with heart disease or high blood pressure. Ask the gate when the one-kilometre walk opens.

Keep this for a separate half-day from the boat. The address is kilometre 16 on the west branch of the Ho Chi Minh road. The minutes from Phong Nha village are check on arrival. Mooc Spring is about 20 minutes from Phong Nha Cave. That drive ends at the spring, and this gate is a different road.

figures.alt: A wooden walkway and stalactites inside Paradise Cave

gettingThere: The address is Km 16 on the west branch of the Ho Chi Minh road. Go by road from the village. The minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Phong Nha village
legs.body: By road to Km 16, west Ho Chi Minh road. The minutes are check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day for the 1 km walk. Confirm the gate on arrival.
admissionNote: Adult 270,000 VND on one tariff, including the entrance and the electric buggy, and 250,000 VND on another. Child from 1.1 m to 1.3 m, 145,000 VND with the buggy. Under 1.1 m free. One set of hours is 06:30–17:00. The one-kilometre gate hours on the other tariff are Check on arrival. The 7 km one-day tour is 2,000,000 VND, minimum two people, starts at 08:00, and ends about 16:00. It kayaks a river 60 to 100 metres across and finishes at Heaven’s Well. That tour is separate from the boardwalk ticket. The overnight tour is 4,000,000 VND, minimum five people, and is closed to children under 16 and to people with heart disease or high blood pressure.
